title: docs(protocol): key i18n bundles on metadata position, not on the label's value
body:
Fixes #17768

Clause-②: no
No authorable surface is widened or narrowed — the diff is one hand-written docs page; no zod schema, resolver, CLI command or Studio code is touched.

## Premise R — which convention the implementations actually key on

The card's uniqueness sentence names four consumers. **All four agree**, so this is the card's expected branch: object-first, **position-derived** keys are the contract, and the flat dialect is corrected with a note saying what it was. Measured on this branch at `b7acd8a8a`:

| Consumer the sentence names | What it keys on | Reading |
|:---|:---|:---|
| the resolvers | position | `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` builds `objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD.label` from the object and field names (`objectFieldLabelKey`, `objectLabelKey`, `viewTranslationKey`, `objectValidationMessageKey`); the authored string is only ever the fallback returned when the bundle has no entry |
| `os i18n extract` | position | `collectExpectedEntries` pushes segment arrays — `pushViewEntries` emits `['objects', objectName, '_views', viewName, 'label']`; the label's value becomes the seed `sourceValue`, never the key |
| `os i18n check` | position | it does not compute an expected set at all: `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts` imports the identical `collectExpectedEntries` |
| the Studio editor | position | its authoring door is `TranslationItemSchema` — the same closed object-first shape plus `locale`. And the card's open question, objectui's `translateLabel`, is measured below |

**objectui, measured (the card explicitly left this for whoever picked it up).** Clone of `objectstack-ai/objectui` at `cfcc17d9dd04ebb80c092cacb4f4034425f51b29`:

- Its own label reads are position-derived and object-first — `objects.{name}.label` (`plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx:99`), `objects.{obj}.fields.{field}.label` (`plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx:795`), `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW.label` (`layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx:191,324`), `objects.OBJECT._sections.KEY.label` (`plugin-form`), and the Studio designer reads the same two families (`app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.tsx:360`).
- `translateLabel` is **not a bundle lookup**. It is module-private to `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:279` and maps eight fixed English tokens (`Details`, `Related`, `Activity`, `History`, `Attachments`, `Approvals`, `Discussion`, `Comments`) into the objectui UI pack via `KNOWN_LABEL_DICT` / `KNOWN_LABEL_KEYS`. Its own contract for anything else: "A token absent from this map (an authored `Invoices` tab) is left alone."

So a label authored as `'account.fields.name'` is not resolved by anybody — it is returned unchanged and renders its own raw dotted key on screen, in every locale. That is the identical failure this page already records for the retired `{ key, defaultValue }` map form.

### Two executed controls

**1. The schema door.** The page's three flat bundles, parsed verbatim through `TranslationDataSchema` (built `packages/spec/dist`), against the page's own object-first example as the firing control:

```
PASS  CONTROL object-first (Object-First Convention section)
FAIL  ObjectQL Integration i18n/en/account.json
      unrecognized_keys ["label","pluralLabel","fields","industries"]
FAIL  ObjectUI Integration i18n/en/account.json
      unrecognized_keys ["list","actions"]
FAIL  Translation File Format i18n/en/account.json
      unrecognized_keys ["account","accounts","fields","welcome","accountCount",
                         "itemCount","itemCount_plural","delete","delete_confirm",
                         "lastUpdated","totalValue","industries"]
```

Since #4001 that rejection fires at both authoring doors, so every bundle the page shipped was unauthorable, not merely unread.

**2. The loader door.** `FileI18nAdapter` over a directory holding both the documented nested layout and the layout it really reads:

```
locales loaded             : ["en"]                      (from i18n/en.json)
t('objects.account.label') : "Account"                   CONTROL — fires
t('account.fields.name')   : "account.fields.name"       the key, returned unchanged
t('fields.name')           : "fields.name"
```

`loadFromDirectory` filters on a `.json` suffix and takes the locale from the file's basename, so `i18n/en/account.json` registers no locale at all.

## What changed

One file, `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`. Sections were located by **content**, not by the card's line numbers — those are stale by construction, the page's last `origin/main` touch (`15805ea32`) being later than the card's measurement at `aaacf1d5c5`. Enumerated by heading sweep (`grep -n '^#\{1,4\} '`) plus a residue sweep for `i18n/LOCALE/NAMESPACE.json` shapes and quoted dotted keys, each zero backed by a firing control.

- **`Directory Structure` → `Where a bundle lives`** — a bundle is a TS module handed to `defineStack`; the one directory the platform reads is `localesDir`, one `LOCALE.json` per locale. Quotes `TranslationConfigSchema`'s own `fileOrganization` tombstone for why no layout is normative.
- **`Translation File Format`** — rewritten onto `TranslationData`, with the eleven declared top-level groups enumerated from the schema (`objects apps messages globalActions dashboards datasets pages flows settings metadataForms settingsCommon`), option maps keyed by stored `value`, and the design-intent formatters named as the non-transformations they are.
- **`Basic Translation` / `Pluralization` / `Context-Based Translation`** — keys moved onto families that exist.
- **`Using Plugin Translations`** — `i18n.t('crm.account.fields.name', 'en')` sat two screens under a bundle declaring `objects.crm_account`; now addresses that bundle, and says why no per-plugin prefix exists (`loadTranslations` deep-merges every plugin into one per-locale `TranslationData`).
- **`ObjectQL Integration` / `ObjectUI Integration`** — labels are authored source-locale text; the bundle is object-first; the load-bearing sentence ("The raw label value stored on the metadata is the translation key") is replaced by the measured rule, and a Callout records what the retired dialect was.
- **Best Practices 1-3** — the ✓GOOD blocks taught the rejected shape; corrected.
- **The uniqueness sentence is KEPT** and made checkable, now naming both retired dialects. Under the card's branch 1 the claim is true; what made it wrong was the page teaching a second shape beside it.

Two incidental corrections the rewrite made unavoidable, both measured:

- `_views.list` → `_views.default`. `expandViewContainer` names an unnamed default `list` container entry `default`; objectui pins this (`ObjectView.defaultViewIdentity.test.tsx`: "does NOT resolve the retired `_views.list` spelling").
- `messages: { 'common.save': … }` → `messages: { commonSave: … }` (two sites). `messages` is a flat record and `t()` walks the key segment by segment, so a dotted id is unreachable. Independently stated in-repo by `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/translations/messages.ts:3-10`, which keeps its own ids single-segment for exactly this reason.

## Verification

Gate sweep derived by the tool, not by hand — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no path list; it derives the change set itself), each exit code captured to disk before any pipe, then reconciled:

```
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 40 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 40 run,
  0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 40 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).
```

40 of 40 exited 0. The first sweep returned five non-zeros that were all **prerequisite, not findings** — `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture` and `check:docs-transcript-drift` at exit 3 on an unbuilt `@objectstack/lint`, and `check:skill-examples` at exit 1 on an unbuilt `@objectstack/client-react`; `check:doc-anchors` at exit 1 was the one real finding (a dead fragment in this diff), fixed in `b7acd8a8a`. The prerequisites were built and the **whole** sweep re-run.

`pnpm lint` is not narrowed here, it is **inapplicable**, and that is a measurement:

1. **Population, read from eslint's own config** — every block in `eslint.config.mjs` is extension-scoped to `{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`; no block names `.mdx`.
2. **Count, read from `--format json`** — `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed file reports 1 file, 0 errors, and one warning: "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied."
3. **Invariance for untouched files** — type-aware linting is enabled nowhere in this repo (`eslint.config.mjs`: "never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules) for ANY file"), so an edit to a file eslint does not read cannot move any other file's verdict.

No package build or test is owed: the diff touches no package, so the affected closure is empty.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`, verified on the publish surface rather than asserted: of 70 non-private packages that declare a `files[]`, **zero** list any `content` or `docs` path, and `apps/docs` — the only consumer of this tree — is `private: true`. Nothing published moves.

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope, noted and not filed — no PR or person is heading for these files, so the carrier is: none.

- The page's `Translation Service Integration`, `Pluralization` and locale-switching sections are design intent and already carry warn Callouts saying so; untouched.
- `Best Practices 4. Test All Locales` shows `renderView('account_list', …)`, an API this repo does not export. Not a bundle-key question, and the block is illustrative test prose.

To file (three-class), with dedupe words:

- **(c) metadata-authoring trap — a dotted `messages` id is authorable and unresolvable.** `messages` is a flat record of id to string, and both `t()` implementations walk the key segment by segment, so `messages: { 'common.save': 'Save' }` saves, validates, and resolves to nothing. `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` teaches the trap in `TranslationItemSchema`'s own `@example` (`messages: { 'common.save': '保存' }`), which is the doorway an agent copies from; `plugin-audit` already documents the rule privately for its own bundle. Nothing rejects a dotted id at either door. Dedupe words: `messages dotted key`, `translation message id segment`, `resolveKey dot walk`, `TranslationItemSchema example`, `single-segment message id`.

Neither of the two incidental corrections above is filed: both are inside this page and are fixed here.
